_comment: Working forecast state. Metric labels must match challenge/companies.json exactly. Deere carries the researched central case; the other three are unresearched and deliberately left null so validation surfaces them rather than hiding a placeholder.

DE._basis: Mean of two independent 24-cell bottom-up builds (12,363 desks / ~12,440 matrix model). Dealer-channel and plant-labour evidence both argue against the low end. Band 12,150-12,600. See dossier/deere/report.html

HD._basis: Bridge from Q2 FY2025 45,277: +1,450 GMS (non-comp to Sept 2026, seasonal peak) +200 Mingledorff's (closed 11 May, revenue undisclosed so absent from most models) +400 new stores/branches +220 comp at +0.5%. Prints 18 Aug 2026.

ADI._basis: Company guidance 3.9bn +/- 100m is the primary anchor; ADI beat its own midpoint in 17 of 18 quarters. Capped below pure beat-extrapolation because auto demand was pulled INTO Q2 per Puccio, 2 Jun 2026. Prints 19 Aug 2026.

HAS._basis: FY2026 ended 30 June 2026. Benchmarked against Hays' OWN company-compiled 9-analyst consensus, updated 11 Aug 2026 - the cleanest benchmark in the challenge.
